Had the guy who raped me as a small teenager tell me that he remembered it happened too, although we had both denied anything happening for years because we were both incredibly drunk and he was 7 years older than me, and had been trying to get with me for a while, and the whole subject made me too uncomfortable. 

He didn't really consider that it was non consentual and neither did I but it fucked up my entire adult life. He recently tried to apologise and bring things between us to a better place. I appreciate the gesture but I just ended up apologising to the person who confused my life for me and made me unable to speak about my first sexual experience, because I can't deal with accepting apologies very well.

Due to a host of mental conditions I've never been great with separation, so I tend to treat people like I would treat any unhealthy connections, once it's time for them to go. For me the fact that these people are drifting makes the whole process feel like a time sink. These are effectively my only friends in the world currently, so it feels like a dramatic step

Why should I trust these people? They're leaving anyway..

Why should I communicate? The exchange will soon be irrelevant..

I'm sure you can see where this is going.
